notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
Major Update

Game has been completely overhauled.
Now has procedurally generated mazes.
Infinite mazes ranging from small to massive.
Achievements have been reworked to match new design.

notes.title: Release day is here, Maze Trials is out now on Steam!
notes.notes:
If you like Mazes check it out.

Maze Trials is a maze running game, find your way out of the mazes, don't forget to collect the key to unlock the exit.

Features: 
- 100 Mazes, gradually getting larger as you progress through the levels
- Find the key to escape each level
- Countdown timer, if timer reaches 0 the level restarts
- Hidden coins on each level to collect and add time to the timer
- Map items give you a preview of the maze for a few seconds and adds time
- Ability to place markers on the maze
- Great background music

If you beat the 100 mazes, you will unlock Maze Rankings and Random Level Selector.
Earn 3 stars by:
1 - Complete the level
2 - Collect all the levels coins
3 - Complete level without collecting maps
